sentences.text:
3. Heard; Smt. Amrin Fathima, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and Smt. Neema T.V., the learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondents and Sri.Anil, the learned counsel appearing for the defacto complainant/ intervenor.
4.

After bestowing my anxious consideration to the facts and the materials placed on record and particularly being prima facie satisfied that the allegations levelled in Annexure A1 FIR are civil in nature and further that the petitioner has no criminal antecedents, I deem it appropriate to pass an interim order, which will do complete justice to both sides.
5. In the result, the petitioner is directed to surrender before the Investigating Officer within one week from today for subjecting himself for interrogation.

After interrogation and in the event of petitioner's arrest, he shall be released on bail on executing bond for Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees one lakh only) with two solvent sureties each to the like sum to the satisfaction of the investigating officer.
This order shall remain in force for a period of three weeks.
